$comment: Soroban contracts this repo consumes. Source of truth: radox-labs/radox-contracts at `commit`. Each entry is one build variant: `features` (exact list, built with `stellar contract build --locked --no-default-features --features ...`; crate defaults never apply because token_sale and transfer_agent default to `testing`), `network` (where that wasm may run) and its `wasm_sha256`. `legacy: true` = installed wasm kept as-is, not reproducible from `commit`. Scripts read hashes through scripts/lib/contracts-lock.mjs. Check with `npm run verify-contracts-lock` (chain), `-- --rebuild` (checkout + rebuild + sha256) or `-- --static` (rules only).

transfer_agent.$note: Legacy (decision G, 16/11): v5 (version() = 5), built 2026-10-06 before the source moved to radox-contracts (radox-core docs/Operations/PROVA_TRANSFER_AGENT_PAUSER_2026-10-06.md); its build flags are not recorded, so `features` is null. Rebuilt at `commit` with rustc 1.86.0 and stellar-cli 28.1.0: crate defaults (`testing`) give 5915649c2fd4ab6aaa93fe90ae718fb8d26826ea39190257f584577cee8e3576, --no-default-features gives 482cba8f5a77f0cf378cf6b359e02c61d5cb044d24b102713b46ad0e34eded4c; neither is the installed wasm. Testnet only; the Rail keeps the installed wasm until the first verified build of a merged commit replaces it.
